name: Diffuze
positioning: One-click listing syndication to 50+ French real estate portals, billed per use, with AI-assisted content.
description: Diffuze is a French listing syndication tool that pushes real estate listings (sale, rental, viager) from a single interface to more than 50 portals including SeLoger, Logic-Immo and Le Figaro Immobilier. It is billed per use rather than by subscription, and includes AI features for description writing and photo retouching.
real_estate_use: An agent or agency uses Diffuze to publish a listing once and have it distributed across dozens of portals within about 24 hours, generate an AI-written description from the property's characteristics, and apply automatic photo retouching or virtual staging, without committing to a monthly subscription for portal access.
features: Syndication to 50+ portals (SeLoger, Logic-Immo, Le Figaro Immobilier, Belles Demeures)
AI photo retouching and virtual staging
Support for sale, rental and viager mandates

use_cases.job: Publish a listing once and distribute it across the main French portals without a portal-by-portal subscription
Generate AI listing descriptions and retouched photos before syndicating a portfolio of mandates
